# EGX BOTS - AI-Powered Egyptian Stock Exchange Analyzer

> EGX BOTS (https://egxbots.com) is the premier quantitative intelligence and AI-driven stock analysis platform dedicated exclusively to the Egyptian Exchange (EGX). It combines machine learning models (AI Score 1 to 10), technical market scanning, backtested trading algorithms, sentiment tracking, and interactive Arabic/English AI financial chat.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Stock Valuation & Scoring**: Daily quantitative machine learning score from 1 (Strong Sell) to 10 (Strong Buy) across 280+ EGX listed equities.
- **Technical Market Screener**: Live scanning of RSI, MACD, 50/200 EMA Golden Crosses, VWAP, Bollinger Bands, and liquidity volume surges in the Egyptian market.
- **Historical Backtesting Engine**: Multi-year quantitative simulations and win-rate statistics based on the Triple Barrier Method and purged K-Fold cross validation.
- **Macro & Market Regime**: Live tracking of EGX 30, EGX 70, USD/EGP currency cycles, and macroeconomic risk regimes.
- **News Sentiment Pulse**: Arabic financial news ingestion, sentiment polarity scoring (-1.0 to +1.0), and corporate event impact alerts.
- **Interactive Financial AI Assistant**: Multilingual financial assistant for chat, portfolio review, and chart image analysis.

## Analytical Methodology
- **Triple Barrier Labeling**: Profit targets, stop loss bounds, and discrete holding periods to prevent arbitrary classification.
- **Leakage Prevention**: Feature shift(1) lag on all technical indicators to ensure no future information leaks into prediction time.
- **Data Freshness**: Synchronized daily with official Egyptian Exchange trading sessions.
